Usage: firecrawl interact stop [options] [scrape-id]

Stop the interactive browser session for a scrape

Arguments:
  scrape-id            Scrape job ID (default: last scrape)

Options:
  -k, --api-key <key>  Firecrawl API key (overrides global --api-key)
  --api-url <url>      API URL (overrides global --api-url)
  -o, --output <path>  Output file path (default: stdout)
  --json               Output as JSON format (default: false)
  -h, --help           display help for command

Examples:
  $ firecrawl interact stop
  $ firecrawl interact stop <scrape-id>
